{"self_assessment": "Impact: I laid the start domino and traced stroke 1, the top line of the fish, from the nose along the back and out around the top tail lobe. That is roughly half of the outline and the piece every other line depends on, since the whole run grows from the start. Before the push, the start reached essentially every domino standing, including the top lobe I built.

Execution: I fetched a full tray of 12 dominoes early so I could begin as soon as the plan was set, and I laid the start and the top line in steady passes without stalling. I used close inspections of the tail area to confirm the top line carried through, and in the final stretch I walked the top line and top tail tip and confirmed everything was standing and connected.

Collaboration: I committed to the fish plan right away and took the stroke Leo and Priya assigned me. I told the table when the start was down so the bottom line could begin. I started the bottom line apart from my own work to avoid bumps, and I stayed clear of the tail neck while Priya finished the lower lobe. I offered to help with the far end of that lobe and left it with her when she preferred to keep it.

Leadership: I took ownership of the most critical stroke and delivered it on time. I kept my updates short and accurate, flagged where I was working so others could stay clear, and did a final check of my section so the table could go into the push with confidence.", "my_share_percent": 30}
